title: Audio Oscillator
text: Generate sine, square, and sawtooth waveforms, 3 inputs, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Signal type} sets Type of generated waveform; {Frequency (Hz)} sets the frequency of generated waveform, {Amplitude}, {Phase offset} sets the normalized phase offset of generated, {DC offset} sets the value added to each element of generated, {Duty cycle} sets the square waveform duty cycle, {Width} sets the sawtooth width, {Samples per frame} sets the number of samples per frame, {Sample rate (Hz)} sets the sample rate of generated waveform, {Output data type} sets the data type of generated and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: F
ports.summary: Frequency (Hz) nonnegative scalar | vector of nonnegative values

ports.name: A
ports.summary: Amplitude nonnegative scalar | vector of nonnegative values

params.name: Signal type
params.values: Type of generated waveform sine (default) | square | sawtooth

params.name: Frequency (Hz)
params.values: Frequency of generated waveform 100 (default) | nonnegative scalar | vector of nonnegative values

params.name: Amplitude
params.values: Amplitude of generated waveform 1 (default) | nonnegative scalar | vector of nonnegative values

params.name: Phase offset
params.values: Normalized phase offset of generated waveform 0 (default) | scalar in the range [0, 1] | vector with values in the range [0, 1]

params.name: DC offset
params.values: Value added to each element of generated waveform 0 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Duty cycle
params.values: Square waveform duty cycle 0.5 (default) | scalar in the range [0, 1]

params.name: Width
params.values: Sawtooth width 1 (default) | scalar in the range [0, 1]

params.name: Samples per frame
params.values: Number of samples per frame 512 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Sample rate (Hz)
params.values: Sample rate of generated waveform 44100 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Data type of generated waveform double (default) | single

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Specify type of simulation to run Code generation (default) | Interpreted execution
